consumer: An ordinary native fixture account starts at Draynor bank with HP10, banked coins and too few mind runes. It runs scripts/magic-order.ts to a requested Magic level. The run buys only the missing runes inside budget and above the cash reserve. It casts wind strike on a safe target, with every cast observed as a rune debit plus an XP change. It banks the leftover runes. It resumes an interrupted session with no reseed and no double purchase. It refuses a rerun at the target, and it refuses short runes when the budget is zero. Independent saved-state checks verify the Magic level and XP effect, the exact rune and coin debit, food eaten, unrelated assets kept, life kept and a confirmed logout.
